svg.text: Qwen2ForCausalLM · TP=1 shapes · N tokens / D hidden / F intermediate / V vocabulary
01 Model path — forward, compute_logits and sample are separate calls
L, D, F, Hq and Hkv come from Qwen2Config.
LM head shares embedding weights only if tie_word_embeddings=True.
inputs_embeds bypasses embedding lookup; generation loop is outside this file.
Input pair: hidden_states h, residual r
r = h if r is None, else r + h
MLP residual add occurs at next layer norm
or at the final model norm
RoPE on Q and K only
d = D / Hq; no Q/K RMSNorm in this implementation.
TP shards Q heads; KV heads are sharded or replicated.
KV cache is not an explicit Qwen2Attention.forward argument.
04 Qwen2MLP — fused gate/up projection, dense SwiGLU
N = tokens processed in this call (vLLM flattened token layout), not a fixed batch × sequence tensor.
Shapes above are logical TP=1 shapes. PP ranks pass hidden_states and residual between layer partitions.
Source: vllm/model_executor/models/qwen2.py @ v0.8.0; RMSNorm and Attention internals checked at the same version.
Embedding-model pooling path is excluded from this causal-LM diagram.
